name: ru.rtln.tds.sdk.ui.activity.OutOfBandChallengeActivity
description: The Tinkoff Acquiring 3-D Secure SDK opens this Activity when a card issuer asks the shopper to confirm a payment through a separate channel. It displays the issuer's instructions and returns the confirmation to the payment flow.
disableEffect: Payments that require this separate confirmation cannot be authenticated and may fail.
